title: Ticket system
description: Tickets opened from a panel, with custom questions, staff and an AI agent per category. The bot picks up settings within a few seconds; refresh the posted panel on the Panel tab.
saved: Saved — the bot will pick it up within a few seconds.
noCategory: None (the bot doesn’t put it in a category)
staffRoleHint: They can see and manage tickets

allowUserClose.label: Members can close their own ticket
allowUserClose.description: When off, only staff can close

requireCloseReason.label: Closing reason required (staff)
requireCloseReason.description: Staff can only close with a reason

dmTranscript.label: Transcript by DM to the opener
dmTranscript.description: When closed, the member receives the conversation

ratingEnabled.label: Ask for a rating when closed
ratingEnabled.description: 1–5 stars and written feedback by DM

menu.label: Dropdown menu
menu.description: One menu with all categories (up to 25)

buttons.label: Buttons
buttons.description: One button per category (up to 15 categories)

panelLive: The panel is posted — refresh it after changing settings or categories.
panelNotLive: The panel hasn’t been posted yet.
categoriesText: Enabled categories appear on the panel. After editing a built-in category, “Reset” restores the default.
emojiHint: A Unicode emoji or one of the server’s own emojis (<:name:id>).
name: Name
question: Question
ownStaffHint: Empty: the ticket system’s staff role
pingRoles: Roles to ping for new tickets
aiInherit: Same as the rest of the system
resetText: All customisations of the category will be lost.
aiEnabledText: Answers common questions and alerts the staff when a human is needed.
personaPlaceholder: e.g. You are a friendly, informal support agent…
knowledgeHint: Rules, FAQ, prices — what the AI answers from

ideas.label: Collect suggestions
ideas.description: Asks questions, summarises and sends it to suggestion review

bugs.label: Collect bug reports
bugs.description: Asks for the details and sends it to bug review

roles.label: Roles from the role picker
roles.description: Adds / removes role-picker roles, following the panel’s rules

nickname.label: Change nickname
nickname.description: Changes the opener’s nickname — no banned words, links or mentions

lookup.label: Own data
lookup.description: Balance, level, invites, warnings — only the ticket opener’s

report.label: Report a member
report.description: Sends a report to the moderators with a link to the ticket

move.label: Move to the right category
move.description: If the ticket was clearly opened in the wrong category

close.label: Close with the member’s consent
close.description: Asks whether it may close the ticket and closes it if yes

blacklistText: People on this list can’t open tickets on this server.

extra.title: Extra ticket panels
extra.description: Post several panels to different channels, each with its own categories (e.g. #purchases with only purchase categories, #support with technical ones). An empty title, text or style falls back to the main panel.
extra.deleteText: The bot also removes the posted message. Open tickets are not affected.
extra.name: Name
extra.nameHint: Only for you, in the list (empty: the channel's name)
extra.categoriesHint: Click to select; if you pick none, the main panel's categories are shown
extra.inheritHint: Empty: same as the main panel
